newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ, FedEx in courier alliance.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ, FedEx in courier alliance.

text.p: Air New Zealand and U.S.-based express distributor Federal Express Corp said on Wednesday they had formed a strategic alliance to offer courier services for New Zealand.
In a joint statement the firms said that customers would gain from a combination of Air NZ's First Express unit and FedEx's network for domestic and international shipments.

"The union will predominantly be a sales and marketing alliance and will provide the two organisations with the opportunity to leverage each other's respective strengths in the competitive New Zealand express transport market," they said.
While extending the international reach of First Express, the alliance would also give FedEx an expanded distribution channel in New Zealand among small to medium sized firms.

Since establishing its business in New Zealand in 1991, FedEx has seen year-on-year growth of 25 percent per annum, mainly on the back of a rapid expansion in high-value exports such as electronics, medical, aircraft and vehicle maintenance items.
No financial details of the expected impact of the alliance on the companies were initially available.
